previous_last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for USB mass-storage decoupling. Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); guide target for a separate docs PR: docs/10-Software/USB-Mass-Storage.md (not claimed public here). The ledger limits the integration merge to the audited original.

decisions.rationale: Makes USB mass storage independently selectable from SD-card logging, including INI-only single-LUN builds, so board and operator behavior needs a guide.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): USB mass storage can be enabled independently of SD-card file logging, allowing INI-only MSD builds without FatFs.

[firmware/hw_layer/mass_storage/mass_storage_init.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/hw_layer/mass_storage/mass_storage_init.cpp): EFI_USB_MSD selects an INI-only LUN without SD support and retains the existing two-LUN layout when logging is present.
guide target: docs/10-Software/USB-Mass-Storage.md (pending separate docs PR; not claimed public)

last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for embedded INI image cluster sizing. Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); no new user setting or workflow requires a guide. The ledger limits the integration merge to the audited original.

decisions.rationale: Reduces FAT image cluster waste while keeping image size and packaged contents unchanged; it introduces no user setting or workflow.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): The embedded INI drive uses 512-byte clusters so the definition and documentation fit without enlarging the image.

[firmware/hw_layer/mass_storage/create_ini_image.sh](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/hw_layer/mass_storage/create_ini_image.sh): The image is created with one sector per cluster and the extraction round-trip preserves the packaged INI.
